text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco's ambassador to Rome condemns acts of racism against Moroccans in Italy and calls on authorities to take urgent steps to arrest those responsible so Moroccan community can live in security.
- Summer university sees need for American and Arab media to end stereotyping of Americans and Arabs.
- Fire in flea market damages 50 stalls but no loss of life.
- Morocco celebrates anniversary of Battle of Three Kings of 1578.
- Royal Air Maroc named official carrier for General Motors convention in Marrakesh next year.
- Three dangerous men belonging to "Boulouhouch" gang arrested, and kidnapped young girl freed.
- U.S. coast guard vessel, USCGC Legare, paying four-day visit to Casablanca.
